findings.title: Shared with hides viewer's own grant from managers
findings.problem: useSharedWith is called with currentUserId for every sharer, and bindSharing (components/sharing/sharingClient.ts:104) filters the current user out of the list. That filter was harmless when only the creator saw the list; now a non-creator manager who also holds a by-name grant is dropped from the list, so users and hasGrants (line 196: users.length > 0) under-report access.
findings.impact: When the manager's own grant is the only one, the panel says 'Not shared with anyone yet.' and the access hint says 'until it is shared', although the app is shared; contradicts AC2 ('shows everyone the app is shared with'). Reachability unconfirmed: depends on whether a manager can also hold a by-name grant.
findings.recommendation: In HostedApplicationDetails pass currentUserId to useSharedWith only for the creator (e.g. currentUserId: creator ? currentUserId : undefined), keeping the shared bindSharing component unchanged (NG3); add an integration test where a non-creator manager is in the shared-with response.
findings.check_notes: useSharedWith now gets currentUserId only when creator; bindSharing unchanged (NG3); integration test covers a non-creator manager holding a grant.

fix.change: HostedApplicationDetails passes currentUserId to useSharedWith only for the creator, so a non-creator manager's own grant stays in Shared with and counts toward hasGrants; bindSharing unchanged
fix.test: HostedApplicationDetails.integration.test.tsx: keeps a manager who is not the creator in Shared with when they hold a grant

findings.title: Access hint ignores grants for sharers without write
findings.problem: The Shared with list is now gated on can_share, but accessHint still returns 'Only signed-in members of your organization can open it.' whenever isManager (write ability) is false, before any grant check.
findings.impact: A user with can_share but no write ability sees a Shared with list next to an access hint that ignores those grants, giving a wrong statement of who can open the link. Reachability unconfirmed: depends on whether the backend ever sends can_share without write.
findings.recommendation: Treat can_share like manager in accessHint, e.g. if (!isManager(app) && !canShare(app)) return 'Only signed-in members of your organization can open it.'
findings.check_notes: accessHint early return now requires !isManager && !canShare; integration test covers can_share with read-only abilities.

fix.change: accessHint returns the organization-members line only when the viewer neither manages nor can share
fix.test: HostedApplicationDetails.integration.test.tsx: derives the access hint from the grants for a sharer without write
